description.value: Outlook Cabin is a seasonal on-course food and drink outlet at Predator Ridge Resort, one of the Okanagan's most acclaimed golf and cycling destinations. It sits mid-round on one of the resort's championship courses, offering golfers quick bites and refreshments during play. Predator Ridge also markets a 'Ride & Stay' package and extensive trail cycling, making the broader resort a legitimate stop for cycling tourists.

address.value: 301 Village Centre Place, Vernon, BC V1H 1T2

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website's 'On Course Outlets' section explicitly names Outlook Cabin as a golf-season mid-round refreshment stop on Predator Ridge Resort's championship courses, confirming it is real and operating. No dedicated amenity details (bike parking, washrooms, refill) are mentioned for this specific outlet; only resort-wide contact information is available from the contact subpage. The OSM amenity=restaurant tag overstates its nature — it is a seasonal, on-course grab-and-go outlet accessible only to golfers actively playing a round.
concerns: Outlook Cabin is an on-course golf refreshment stop accessible only to golfers mid-round during golf season, not a standalone publicly accessible restaurant as the OSM amenity=restaurant tag implies.
No dedicated address, phone, or contact info exists for Outlook Cabin itself — resort-level contact details used as proxy.
OSM community listed as 'Oyama' but Predator Ridge Resort's mailing address is Vernon, BC.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Outlook Cabin is a real, operating seasonal food and drink outlet at a well-known public resort. Access requires playing golf on the course, but it is a legitimate publicly accessible food service venue and the broader Predator Ridge site is highly relevant to cycling tourists.
enrichment_extras.notes: Predator Ridge actively promotes cycling (biking listed in Activities, Ride & Stay package) and rents bikes on site; the broader resort campus is relevant to cycling tourists even if this specific outlet is golf-course-only.

wow_evidence: seasonal on-course food and drink outlet at Predator Ridge Resort ... accessible only to golfers actively playing a round
